## Summary
Sameera Bhanu is a fast-learning 1st-year B.Tech IT student who embarked on frontend engineering four months ago (July 2026). In four months of intensive development, she has engineered 6+ practical web applications from scratch using semantic HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript, and React. She creates custom design systems including Neumorphic (Soft UI) interfaces, interactive canvas visualizations (FlowField particle wind), and 3D card physics (CardStack).

## Core Technical Skills

- Frameworks & Libraries: React 19, React Router, Vite, Context API, Lucide Icons, Canvas Confetti
- Design Systems & Styling: Neumorphism (Soft UI dual shadows), Frosted Glassmorphism, Skeuomorphic tactile design, Mobile-first Responsive Design
- Development Tools: Git, GitHub, Browser DevTools, VS Code, REST APIs, LocalStorage
